benchmark_mfg_algorithms: benchmark MFG algorithms and environments by running the CLI with --games and --parameters flags
convert_param_spec: convert a parameter specification string like 'size:10;200' into a tuple of name and integer list
run_fictitious_play_benchmark: run fictitious play iteration timing benchmark on specified MFG game with parameter sweep
load_mfg_game: load an MFG game from pyspiel with configurable parameters for benchmarking
sweep_game_parameters: sweep over multiple game parameter combinations and collect fictitious play iteration timings
